title: Vertex Posets, Monotone Path Polytopes, and Chow Polynomials
summary: Let $P\subset\mathbb R^n$ be a convex polytope and let $\ell$ be a linear functional which is nonconstant on every edge of $P$. The induced acyclic orientation determines positive and negative Białynicki-Birula type partitions of $P$ into unions of relative interiors of faces. Our first result establishes a duality: the positive partition is a stratification if and only if the negative one is a stratification.
